## The problem

What are you trying to do that modsearch cannot do today? Describe the situation,
not just the solution you have in mind.

## What you would like

A clear description of the change or new capability.

## Alternatives you considered

Other ways to get there, and why they fall short.

## Scope check

ModSearch handles the live web: search, page fetch, and X. Image parsing lives
in the separate `modlens` project. If your idea is about a new search or fetch
engine, say which one and what it needs to run (key, binary, sign-in).
